protocol.static_scope: All29 reviewed video frames and132 image-dev samples. Reproduce unchanged classwise native output; cache FP32 old190/A0 ensemble/A0 member three-class probabilities and model-grid probabilities. Reference never enters inference
protocol.full_video_policy: User requires EVERY actually implemented comparison scheme to run on both complete videos, even when static screening fails. No static failure exempts a scheme from full-video performance/failure testing. Absence of dense GT still forbids dense accuracy claims. D0 introduces no new segmentation scheme: test frozen classwise baseline on722+1972 sequential frames in a fresh process per video. Future A+/B/C/D need their own frozen all-video execution protocols

full_video_baseline.scope: Include all2694 frames in native pipeline P50/P95, peak allocation and full decode/render/export throughput. Pipeline timing excludes reference auditing and disk exports; full cycle includes them. Offline throughput is not live display/queue acceptance

diagnostic_only.axis: PCA of ALL reference fiber pixels, orient by median estimated-FOV distance at5/95 percentiles; no largest-component selection. Skip axial statistics if orientation ambiguous; this is a GT-conditioned measurement, never an inference input or anatomical tip truth

protocol.pilot_policy: 12 pending sidecar requests,6 per case, include existing successes and failures. Never auto-populate tip/shaft labels, points or visibility from predictions. Original29 masks unchanged; dedicated tip metrics remain null until independently reviewed
protocol.stop: Any baseline reproduction/identity failure stops this run; do not fix by selecting thresholds. D0 only diagnoses; no color/geometry model fitting, segmentation changes, training, default adoption, S3 or A+ execution
protocol.constraints: No TRAIN pixel reads or source statistical fitting in D0; no144 reserved-test pixels; stone_new remains excluded; video1/2 validation only;521/132/144/29 and all labels/checkpoints unchanged
